tools.name: revoke_adjuster_access_and_purge_drafts
tools.description: Removes an adjuster's access to a claim by deleting their role assignment, and permanently deletes any unsubmitted draft notes that adjuster wrote on that claim.

params.name: adjuster_id
params.description: Identifier of the adjuster whose access is revoked

tools.code:
import sqlite3

DATABASE_PATH = "claims.db"


def revoke_adjuster_access_and_purge_drafts(claim_id: str, adjuster_id: str) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()
        database_cursor.execute(
            "DELETE FROM claim_role_assignments WHERE claim_id = ? AND adjuster_id = ?",
            (claim_id, adjuster_id),
        )
        number_of_role_assignments_removed = database_cursor.rowcount
        database_cursor.execute(
            "DELETE FROM claim_notes WHERE claim_id = ? AND author_id = ? AND status = 'draft'",
            (claim_id, adjuster_id),
        )
        number_of_draft_notes_deleted = database_cursor.rowcount
        database_connection.commit()
    except Exception:
        database_connection.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        database_connection.close()
    return {
        "claim_id": claim_id,
        "adjuster_id": adjuster_id,
        "role_assignments_removed": number_of_role_assignments_removed,
        "draft_notes_deleted": number_of_draft_notes_deleted,
    }

tools.name: archive_closed_claim_documents
tools.description: Moves all documents for a closed claim from the active claims folder into the archive folder, organized by year.

params.name: active_root
params.description: Root directory of active claim files

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path


def _unique_destination(target_directory: Path, file_name: str) -> Path:
    candidate = target_directory / file_name
    counter = 1
    while candidate.exists():
        candidate = target_directory / f"{candidate.stem}_{counter}{Path(file_name).suffix}"
        counter += 1
    return candidate


def archive_closed_claim_documents(
    claim_id: str,
    closure_year: int,
    active_root: str = "/data/claims/active",
    archive_root: str = "/data/claims/archive",
) -> dict:
    source_directory = Path(active_root) / claim_id
    if not source_directory.is_dir():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No active folder for claim {claim_id}")

    destination_directory = Path(archive_root) / str(closure_year) / claim_id
    destination_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    moved_files = []
    for item in sorted(source_directory.rglob("*")):
        if not item.is_file():
            continue
        relative_parent = item.parent.relative_to(source_directory)
        target_directory = destination_directory / relative_parent
        target_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        final_path = _unique_destination(target_directory, item.name)
        shutil.move(str(item), str(final_path))
        moved_files.append(str(final_path))

    return {
        "claim_id": claim_id,
        "archive_directory": str(destination_directory),
        "files_moved": len(moved_files),
        "paths": moved_files,
    }

tools.name: delete_duplicate_claim_record
tools.description: Permanently deletes a duplicate claim record and its line items, and updates the original claim to note which duplicate was removed.

params.name: dup_id
params.description: Claim ID of the duplicate to delete

params.name: orig_id
params.description: Claim ID of the original to keep

tools.code:
import sqlite3

mcp = None
try:
    from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
    mcp = FastMCP("claims")
except ImportError:
    pass


@mcp.tool()
def delete_duplicate_claim_record(dup_id: str, orig_id: str) -> str:
    db = sqlite3.connect("claims.db")
    try:
        cur = db.cursor()
        row = cur.execute("SELECT id FROM claims WHERE id = ?", (orig_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return f"Original claim {orig_id} not found"
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM claim_line_items WHERE claim_id = ?", (dup_id,))
        n = cur.execute("DELETE FROM claims WHERE id = ?", (dup_id,)).rowcount
        cur.execute(
            "UPDATE claims SET notes = COALESCE(notes, '') || ? WHERE id = ?",
            (f"\nDuplicate {dup_id} removed", orig_id),
        )
        db.commit()
    except Exception:
        db.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        db.close()
    return f"Deleted {n} duplicate claim(s); updated {orig_id}"
